comments: Keep transformation_plate at 4 °C (cold block or thermocycler, lid open) while pipetting.
Thermocycler, lid closed: 4 °C 30 min with the DNA, heat shock at 42 °C for 30 s, back to 4 °C for 2 min.
Thermocycler: recover at 37 °C for 1 h, then hold at 4 °C. Spot the transformations on selective agar.
